historical_reviews.v3_1: The two views must independently show live continuity, not two screenshots of cached output. A unique harmless marker and controlled focus handoff distinguish live same-channel behavior from stale or duplicated presentation.

original_test_intent: Manually prove that the embedded and Open in new tab BMC SOL views both attach to the intended live serial channel and accept/display controlled harmless input correctly.
original_method: An authorized operator verifies BMC, SUT, serial channel and safe prompt, opens the embedded SOL view, types a unique harmless marker and observes live echo/order/focus, opens the new-tab view, re-verifies identity and session behavior with a second marker, records drops/duplicates/latency, then exits the prompt and closes both sessions without altering SUT state.
manual_activity: The operator visually establishes live console context, controls focus and harmless input in both UI presentations, detects stale/duplicate/lost output and safely closes the serial sessions.
required_inputs: Authoritative serial channel and console parameters
Authorized BMC Web account and compatible browser
Safe disposable prompt or owner-approved non-destructive input surface
safety_requirements: Do not substitute SSH, IPMI SOL CLI or screenshots for the Web UI interaction
Confirm target, channel and prompt before every input
Never type credentials, secrets, bootloader actions or side-effecting commands
Stop on ambiguous focus, stale output, loss, duplication, wrong target or locked session
Do not issue power or reset actions for recovery
Preserve logs rather than clearing them
Close both sessions and verify no orphaned lock
agent_execution_scope: Prepare the operator checklist and safe marker values
Record supplied screenshots, timestamps and observations
Compare the embedded and new-tab evidence
Report omissions and anomalies without driving the console or assigning verdict
engineer_actions: Confirm live identity, focus, echo and continuity
Stop and recover any locked or misdirected session

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The non-runnable note correctly identifies the human UI requirement and must remain; no shell command can establish both visual console images and controlled focus.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a human-observed WebUI checklist with distinct harmless markers in the embedded and new-tab SOL views.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Both UI views, typing interaction and 10/10-minute estimates remain; words are constrained to harmless unique markers.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture before/after screenshots and a timestamped operator ledger for target/channel, marker sent, marker observed, focus, latency, loss/duplication and session closure in each view.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines workable as live, correctly focused, same-target serial interaction rather than mere image visibility.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: API or CLI session health may support diagnosis but cannot replace the source-required embedded and new-tab Web presentations.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent views can share or contend for one SOL session; input focus or cached scrollback can make a non-live view appear functional.

project_override_considerations: The Project must identify the serial channel, safe prompt and whether the two views share or replace a session. Any CLI SOL test is supporting evidence only and cannot satisfy this Web UI case.
expected_evidence: BMC/SUT/serial-channel identity, browser, console parameters and safe-prompt approval
Embedded-view screenshot and live first-marker echo/focus/latency observation
New-tab screenshot, independently rechecked identity and live second-marker behavior
Drop, duplicate, stale-output, focus and concurrent-session observations
Preserved audit/SEL/OS evidence and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently require two interactive SOL Web views; the word image refers to the visible console presentation rather than a static file.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The browser, operator, channel and safe prompt are normal project prerequisites; the manual workflow is fully identifiable.

review_improvement: Turns vague typing into a safe dual-view liveness and focus test with explicit cleanup while retaining the required human visual oracle.
independent_technical_reasoning: Serial consoles are stateful input channels. Seeing identical text in two windows can result from scrollback or a shared stale buffer, while sending input from the wrong focused window can reach a privileged prompt. Distinct markers, fresh output and an operator-controlled focus transition are necessary to prove each presentation is workable safely.
